title: Part-Time SW Product Design Engineer
desc:
P.I. Works is the first company in the world to automate the management of a commercial 5G network.
Our automated network management products and services empower Mobile Operators to accelerate network transformation and to drive network quality and efficiency on the path to 5G.
These solutions have been deployed across 87 mobile network operators in 60 countries around the world.
Come and join us to work with the leading telecom operators around the world and redefine the mobile experience worldwide by contributing to our research and development efforts while continuing your studies. This part-time experience is designed for students who want to gain hands-on industry experience alongside their academic life.
What you will have
An opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds in the Software & Telecom industry
Hands-on opportunities to learn from the best and put your knowledge and skills to work
A mentor to help you build and develop your potential
A friendly, open and collaborative environment that thrives on learning and practicing
Job Description
Involve in dedicated on the job training program on Telecommunication and Software products with the help of a mentor guiding you.
Understand and improve the functionalities of mobile network automation solutions based on mobile operator’s needs & requirements world-wide
Design user interface, concept sketches, and high-fidelity wireframes by using design tools
Test and validate solutions based on technical requirements and user experience
Requirements for the position
Pursuing an engineering degree on 3rd class in relevant university departments such as Electrical, Electronics, Communications, Computer or Software Engineering
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English is must
Energetic, enthusiastic, curious and open for improvement
Programming (SQL, Python etc.) knowledge is a plus
Good understanding of mobile telecommunication technologies is a plus
Eligible to work in Turkey
Apply today and unlock your potential!
